entries.name: Herman Ferguson

expected.charges: Conspiracy to murder Roy Wilkins (NAACP) and Whitney Young (National Urban League)
expected.sentence:
3.5 to 7 years New York state prison; served 3 years after voluntary 1989 return from 20 years of exile in Guyana

Verdict as recorded: Yes — New York state jury verdict, 1968

updates.sentence: Three and one-half to seven years for the 1968 conviction. Released on appeal bond before leaving for Guyana; returned April 6, 1989 and was immediately arrested, beginning sentence service April 7. This custody start covers the later return, not uninterrupted imprisonment from the original 1967 arrest. The pre-existing April 14, 1992 release date is retained but not independently verified by this review.

entries.name: George Jackson

expected.charges: Originally one year to life for $70 gas station robbery (1961); later charged in January 1970 with the murder of Soledad guard John Mills (Soledad Brothers case); killed by guards at San Quentin August 21, 1971 in alleged escape attempt before trial
expected.sentence:
One year to life on the original 1961 conviction; killed in custody at San Quentin August 21, 1971 at age 29

Verdict as recorded: Yes — 1961 California state conviction; never tried on the Mills killing

entries.rationale: Correct death in custody endpoint to August 21, 1971, not a release on August 20. Mirror the death date in release_date as required by the existing model convention; preserve custody onset.

entries.name: Eldridge Cleaver

expected.charges: Attempted murder of Oakland police officers (April 6, 1968 shootout); parole violation
expected.sentence:
Served approximately 8 years on the run in Cuba, Algeria, and France; minor probation after surrender

Verdict as recorded: Pleaded guilty to lesser charges after voluntary 1975 return from exile

entries.rationale: Court record establishes April 6, 1968 arrest and immediate custody; contemporary June 12 dispatch establishes physical release that afternoon. Preserve exile fields and all biographies.
